# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 7 priority parameter families have provenance metadata: process/default.toml carries 36 param_meta entries covering AOB/NOB/comammox K_s values (6 entries), all nitrifier and decomposer vmax/growth_yield/decay_rate controls (12 entries), denitrification parameters (5 entries), stoichiometric constants (2 entries), and plant/algae growth rate maxima (4 entries). neocaridina_davidi.toml carries 18 param_meta entries covering shrimp reproduction temperature curves, molt mineral thresholds, chloride-nitrite protection, TAN/NO2 suppression endpoints, and condition/molt-stress/NH3 tunables.
- Confidence tiers are explicit and machine-readable throughout: process param_meta entries span literature (18), expert (8), and heuristic (10) tiers; shrimp param_meta entries span literature (2), expert (6), heuristic (9), and placeholder (1). PROVENANCE_STATUS.md opens with a four-tier definition table (literature/expert/heuristic/placeholder) with clear action-needed columns.
- Legacy param_meta migration bug (fr-3-92da51e1 from prior final review) is fixed: migrate_legacy_process_param_meta_key() now calls normalize_legacy_process_param_meta() which rewrites the unit field to the canonical unit and scales valid_range bounds through the same transform function used for the numeric value. Verified by regression test test_process_preset_parser_migrates_legacy_nitrogen_param_meta_range_units.
- ATMOSPHERIC_CO2_PPM (fr-3-7fd25e44 from prior final review) now carries a doc comment citing 'rounded NOAA background-atmosphere anchor from the late-2010s / ~2020 global mean envelope', confidence expert, and explicitly noting it is held fixed for the current model scope.
- Missing biomass-rate provenance (fr-3-f497e356 from prior final review) is resolved: all 12 decomposer/AOB/NOB/comammox vmax, growth_yield, and decay_rate parameters now have param_meta with explicit confidence (heuristic for vmax, expert for yield/decay) and derivation notes. Locked by regression test shipped_process_biomass_rate_controls_have_provenance_metadata.
- Developer-facing summary docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md (175 lines) distinguishes strong anchors from provisional approximations with dedicated sections for Nitrogen Kinetics (strong anchors + biomass-rate controls), Denitrification, Carbonate Chemistry (code-resident constants + source-water presets), Habitat/Biofilter Scaling, and Shrimp Biology. Includes 'How to Use This Summary' section and lists parameters not yet annotated.
- Enriched TOML files load through standard serde deserialization with no special-case hacks. param_meta is optional via serde defaults. All tests pass: tank_data 41 tests, tank_core 500+ tests across unit and integration suites, tank_scenarios all green. Clippy clean across all three packages with zero warnings.
- Denitrification fields propagate end-to-end through ProcessParamsPreset → scenario materialization → runtime ProcessParams, verified by test process_preset_mapping_carries_denitrification_fields. Prior self-referencing TODO replaced with 5 formal param_meta entries.
- Representative enriched files exist for each parameter family: default.toml (process/nitrogen kinetics/denitrification), neocaridina_davidi.toml (shrimp), hard_shrimp.toml and moderate.toml (source-water), active_planted.toml and coarse_porous.toml (substrate).

## Findings and Gaps

- soft_acidic.toml and ro_like.toml source-water profiles lack per-parameter param_meta. Documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md as lower priority; representative coverage is met via hard_shrimp.toml and moderate.toml.
- inert_sand.toml and inert_gravel.toml substrate files lack colonizable_area_factor param_meta. Representative coverage is met via active_planted.toml and coarse_porous.toml.
- Carbonate solver constants (pKa1, pKa2, K_H) use doc-comment provenance rather than TOML param_meta since they are code-resident constants not TOML-loaded presets. This is an intentional design choice documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md and the chemistry.rs header comment.
- Process routing fractions (assimilation, respiration, excretion splits) and thermal transport constants remain listed as pending future annotation in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md.
- The alkalinity budget unit-safety concern (meq stored in mg-named fields in a separate worktree) remains unresolved but is correctly out-of-scope for this provenance-focused bead.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
